subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require a redacted live current-main multi-account Slack Socket Mode reaction trace before allowing a fix PR, or should this be folded into the broader Slack Socket Mode liveness investigation now?
rationale: Source inspection shows handler support plus several plausible drop boundaries, but not the first failing boundary in the reporter's live setup, so an automated fix would be guessing.

options.title: Keep reaction-specific and require live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted current-main reaction envelopes, trace logs, and account ids before code changes.

options.title: Fold into liveness issue
options.body: Treat the report as another symptom of the broader Slack Socket Mode stale-transport problem if maintainers believe reaction-only diagnostics are no longer useful.

options.title: Queue a speculative repair
options.body: Let automation attempt a narrow Slack reaction fix without live proof, accepting a high chance of patching the wrong boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep reaction-specific and require live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted current-main reaction envelopes, trace logs, and account ids before code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal is on Slack monitor filtering, system-event movement, and Socket Mode liveness paths.
